name: The Princess Trapped

angles.text: As a shaman, you commune with elemental spirits and may recognize Myzrael’s claim to be an earth princess. Her imprisonment underground calls for careful scrutiny of the elements.
As a mage, you may find the resonant shards and motes of earth energy a curious way to communicate and channel power across great distances.
As a miner, you may encounter Drywhisker kobolds near the gorge and in underground veins in Arathi. You may also find the enchanted crystal shards tied to the princess.

aliases: who is talking through the crystal
faq.answer: Myzrael is the voice speaking through the crystal. She calls herself a princess of the earth, imprisoned deep beneath the Arathi Highlands, and calls to passing travelers for help reaching the surface.
Myzrael says giants imprisoned her beneath Arathi. They bound her deep underground, so she relies on shards scattered across the region to speak with those above.
faq.q: Who trapped Myzrael beneath the highlands?

aliases: why do the kobolds have motes
faq.answer: Motes of Myzrael are crystalline or elemental fragments carried by Drywhisker kobolds. Myzrael says they hold enough latent earth power to activate the shard clusters and strengthen her link to the surface.
faq.q: What are the Motes of Myzrael?

faq.answer: Myzrael says the Drywhisker kobolds in Drywhisker Gorge are allies of the giants who imprisoned her. They guard a crystal shard cluster in the gorge, between the princess and the surface.
faq.q: How are the Drywhisker kobolds connected to Myzrael's captors?

faq.answer: Myzrael sends her voice through iridescent crystal shards that protrude from the soil of the Arathi Highlands. The shards carry her voice through the depths to people on the surface.
faq.q: How is Myzrael able to speak from underground?

aliases: where do i take the motes
faq.answer: Drywhisker Gorge is a rugged cleft in eastern Arathi Highlands. Drywhisker kobolds live there and surround the iridescent shard cluster Myzrael asks you to empower with the gathered motes.

sections.body: Strange shards lie scattered across the Arathi Highlands, humming with distant power. Near them, Myzrael’s voice rises from deep beneath the ground. She calls herself a princess of the earth, cast down and bound underground by ancient giants. Cut off from the lands above, she uses the crystals to carry her plea to anyone willing to listen.
sections.title: A Voice from the Stone

sections.body: Myzrael directs you east to Drywhisker Gorge, where she asks you to strengthen your contact with her. Drywhisker kobolds infest the gorge, and she calls them allies of the giants who hold her captive. They carry Motes of Myzrael and guard a cluster of iridescent shards. Take the motes from the kobolds and use their energy on the formation. That will strengthen the crystal cluster and deepen your communication with the trapped princess.
sections.title: The Drywhisker Connection

summary: Across the Arathi Highlands, an iridescent shard carries Myzrael’s plea from deep underground. She calls herself a princess of the earth, imprisoned by giants, and asks travelers to strengthen a crystal cluster in Drywhisker Gorge.
attribution: In-game quest text: The Princess Trapped
